Verify Now Blog > How to Place PCBWay Orders from Online 3D Viewer Directly？ How to Place PCBWay Orders from Online 3D Viewer Directly？ by: PCBWay Jan 13,2023 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in Help Center Online 3D Viewer ( https://3dviewer.net/ ) is popular among 3D Printing hobbyists for its simple page and excellent viewing capabilities. For the convenience of all, we have good news: PCBWay has partnered with Online 3D Viewer to include a built-in plugin that allows designers to place PCBWay orders directly from the viewer. This article is going to show the steps: 1. Enter Online 3D Viewer and open your file. 2. Find the icon indicated by the arrow and click it. 3. Click Print and enter PCBWay. 4. Select the appropriate parameters according to the specific needs of the project, and the system will conduct a rough quotation. 5. Click Submit Request , the staff will give a final price based on the parts to be printed and the parameters selected. 6. Finished. PCBWay has always been committed to providing customers with better services. In the future, we will also work hard to reach cooperation with more software and practice the goal of one-stop service.
